Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1487
Claimant:
Zachary Huerta
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
11-24-23
Claim opened after a low-speed head-on collision reported by the insured's driver, who is named on the policy. The
claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go thorugh the attorney's office.
12-5-23
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehcile at the time of the collision. The officer's
description of the scene lines up with the account given to us.
12-15-23
Obtained statements from two witnesses and the other driver. Each describes the accident in the same way, and
none of them contradicts the others on the sequence of events.
1-10-24
Photographs of the vehicles were reviewed. The damage is mostly consistent with the impact described, with the
front-end crush and airbag deployment matching a head-on contact at low speed.
2-23-24
Reviewed the claimant's first medical records, which report neck and back strain. The kind of injury reported fits the
force of a collision of this type.
3-16-24
No prior injury or treatment to the neck or back has come up in records or in discussion with counsel so far.
3-27-24
Checked vehicle history. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on record, and nothing suggests the damage predates
the start of coverage.
4-20-24
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the claimant's account. The claimant has given the same
description of the accident in every conversation so far.
5-6-24
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this kind. Requested updated treatment notes
and billing to understand the course of care.
5-9-24
Received the updated records. The treating provider's notes are consistent with the earlier reports, and the extended
treatment is documented with reasons for each visit.
6-15-24
Claim remains open pending review of the final bills and the attorney's demand. Next step is to schedule a file review
once those documents arrive.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
